name: orchidshield-host-compromise-bn
description: Per-host compromise network. Binary nodes. CPT entries give P(node=true | parents) keyed by parent truth values in parent order ('T'/'F', comma separated; '' for roots). Hand-elicited priors, sanity-checked against the synthetic generator in 02_simulation.ipynb.

nodes.name: ThreatActive
nodes.doc: An adversary campaign is targeting this host's segment (latent).

nodes.name: Maintenance
nodes.doc: Approved maintenance window (benign explanation for anomalies).

nodes.name: IOCMatch
nodes.doc: Any alert on the host matched a known-bad indicator.

nodes.name: AuthAnomaly
nodes.doc: Success-after-failures or impossible travel on the host. Maintenance explains away.

nodes.name: EDRDetection
nodes.doc: EDR raised an execution-class detection. Unobserved when the host has no EDR.

nodes.name: LateralSignal
nodes.doc: Lateral-movement or exfiltration alert on the host.

nodes.name: AnalystFP
nodes.doc: An analyst marked an alert on the host as false positive.
